school.helpWhatText: The School module lets you keep track of your children's school life. Here you can store contact teachers and subject teachers, health and administrative staff (principal, school nurse etc.), classmates with guardians, schedules, holidays and activities for each school year. Use the search field to filter contacts and holidays.
school.helpHowText:
1. Add a child with name, school and photo.
2. Select or create a school year with a grade.
3. Add contact teachers, health/admin staff and classmates with guardians, or import the class list from a photo with AI.
4. Upload schedule images for autumn and spring.
5. Add holidays manually, import from a photo with AI or from a URL.
6. Add activities such as trips and school events with location, reminders and documents.
school.helpTip: Each school year has its own contacts, schedules, holidays and activities. Old data is kept as history. Long-press an item to edit or delete it — holidays can also be edited by tapping them.
school.helpHolidaysText:
Holidays show school vacations and planning days for the child. Each holiday displays an icon, title, dates and how far away it is.

You can:
• Add holidays manually
• Import from photo with AI
• Import from a URL (link to school website)

Holidays also appear in the weekly summary (My week) along with other events.
school.helpHolidaysTip: Holidays are sorted with upcoming first. The badge shows whether the holiday is today, in X days, or X days ago.
school.helpSettingsText: You can edit and delete children, contacts, schedules, holidays and activities by long-pressing the item. Activities sync to the family's Google calendar and trigger push notifications to the family.

health.helpWhatText: The Health module lets you keep track of medications, appointments, vaccinations, allergies and growth for everyone in the family. Appointments and vaccinations automatically appear in Events and 'Your week', and sync to the family's Google calendar.
health.helpMedicationsText: Add medications with name, person, dosage and frequency (1–4 times daily) with times and reminders per dose. You can also set a validity period and notes.
health.helpAppointmentsText: Plan doctor visits and dental appointments with multiple family members, doctor, location with map, reminders and documents. You can schedule repeats (e.g. every other week), and on web you can add the appointment directly to Google or Outlook calendar.
health.helpHowText: Tap '+' in a section to add something new. Tap an item to view details (with map and edit button where relevant). Long-press an item to edit or delete it.
health.helpTip: New appointments and vaccinations trigger push notifications to the family, appear in 'Your week' and sync to the family's Google calendar.

profile.title: Profile
profile.noFamily: You are not in a family yet.
profile.createFamilyHint: Or use an invite link to join an existing family.

profile.linkHint: Share the link with someone who wants to join. Link expires after 1 hour.

profile.helpCalendarWhatText: The Calendar setting controls how your family's events are stored in calendars. Choose '📱 Phone calendar' to automatically add events, appointments, vaccinations and trips to your phone's calendar. Choose '📧 Google Calendar' to connect the family to a shared Google calendar.
profile.helpCalendarHowText:
1. Choose '📱 Phone calendar' or '📧 Google Calendar'.
2. For Google: enter your email (optional) and tap 'Connect Google', then approve access on Google's sign-in page.
3. Events sync automatically to the selected calendar.
4. Owners can also run 'Google Calendar sync' to backfill the calendar with existing events.
profile.helpCalendarTip: You can disconnect the Google calendar at any time with 'Disconnect calendar'. All events remain in the app.
profile.helpNotificationsWhatText: Notifications control whether you receive push notifications in the app when family members add or change content, such as new events and service appointments.
profile.helpNotificationsHowText: Tap the button to turn notifications on or off. When set to 'Off', you will not receive push notifications on your own devices — other family members are not affected.
profile.helpMinUkeWhatText: Choose whether the weekly menu is shown in the 'Your week' summary on the Events screen. Hide the section if you don't need to see the meal plan there.
profile.helpMinUkeHowText: Toggle the 'Weekly menu' switch on or off. The change takes effect the next time you open 'Your week'.
profile.helpMinUkeTip: Which meal types (breakfast, lunch, dinner) are shown is controlled by the Food Center settings just below.
profile.helpMatsenterWhatText: Choose which meal types are shown in the weekly menu and in the 'Your week' summary: breakfast, lunch and dinner.
profile.helpMatsenterHowText: Toggle breakfast, lunch and dinner on or off. Only active meals appear in the weekly menu and in 'Your week'.
profile.helpMatsenterTip: Changes apply immediately in the Food Center and in 'Your week' on the Events screen.
profile.helpBirthdaysWhatText: Manage the family's birthdays. Birthdays appear in the Birthdays module, on the Events screen and in 'Your week'.
profile.helpBirthdaysHowText: Open the Birthdays module and tap '+' to add a birthday. Long-press a birthday to edit or delete it.
profile.helpBrightnessHowText: Tap 'Add birthday' to add a new one. Enter the name and select a date. The birthday is added as an annual event.
profile.helpBirthdaysTip: Birthdays appear automatically on the Events screen as they approach.
profile.helpFamilyWhatText: Manage family members, roles and invitations. Only owners and admins can generate invite links, change roles and remove members.
profile.helpFamilyHowText: Tap 'Generate link' to create an invite link with a 6-character code. Tap 'Share link' to share it with the person joining. Owners and admins can also change roles by tapping the role, and remove members from the list.
profile.helpFamilyTip: Invite links expire after 1 hour and can only be used once. Members can leave the family with 'Leave family'.
profile.helpMembersWhatText: Family members have different roles that determine what they can do in the app. There are three roles: Owner, Admin and Member.
profile.helpMembersOwnerText: The owner has full access. Can change all roles, remove members, delete all content and manage all settings. Only one person can be the owner.
profile.helpMembersAdminText: Administrators can invite new members, change roles (except the owner), remove members and delete content created by others.
profile.helpMembersMemberText: Members can view and add events, trips, recipes and shopping lists. They can only delete their own content.
profile.helpMembersHowText: Tap the role next to a member's name to change between Admin and Member. Only owners and administrators can change roles.
profile.helpMembersTip: The owner cannot be removed or lose the owner role.
profile.helpSpondWhatText: Connect to Spond to show your team's events directly in the app. Only owners and admins see this section. Spond events appear automatically on the Events screen, where family members can respond.
profile.helpSpondHowText:
1. Enter your Spond email and password, then tap 'Connect to Spond'.
2. Choose which groups to show (and upload a group logo if you like).
3. Choose which respondents may sign up under 'Choose respondents'.
4. Tap 'Save' — without saving, no Spond events will appear.
profile.helpSpondTip: Your Spond password is stored securely (encrypted). You can disconnect at any time with 'Disconnect Spond'.

detail.helpTransportWhatText: Add flights, trains, rental cars, cruises, ferries and taxis for the trip. Outbound and return journeys are entered in separate tabs, and the round trip appears as a single combined item in the list.
detail.helpTransportHowText: Tap '+' and choose the transport type. Fill in operator, route/flight number, reference (PNR), seat, dates and times, and addresses. Turn off 'One way' to register both outbound and return journeys.
detail.helpTransportTip: Long-press a transport to edit or delete it. Only the owner, admins and the person who created it can edit it.
detail.helpHotelsWhatText: Manage accommodation for the trip. Add hotels with name, address, phone, dates and check-in/check-out times.
detail.helpHotelsHowText: Tap '+' and fill in the hotel's name, address (Google search), check-in and check-out dates and times, phone and any notes. Tap a hotel for details with a map.
detail.helpHotelsTip: You can add several hotels for different parts of the trip.
detail.helpRestaurantsWhatText: Plan places to eat for the trip. Add restaurants with name, address, date, time and notes.
detail.helpRestaurantsHowText: Tap '+' and fill in the name, address (Google search), date and time, and any notes — such as reservation details. Tap a restaurant for details with a map.
detail.helpRestaurantsTip: You can add several restaurants and edit them later by long-pressing.
detail.helpActivitiesWhatText: Plan activities and experiences for the trip. Add sights, hikes and events with date, time and location.
detail.helpActivitiesHowText: Tap '+' and fill in the name, address (Google search), date and time, and notes. Tap an activity for details with a map.
detail.helpActivitiesTip: You can add several activities and edit them later by long-pressing.
detail.helpTipsWhatText: Get AI-generated tips for your destination — based on your travel dates and the weather forecast. You get an overview, things to do, restaurants, useful phrases with pronunciation, transport and warnings.
detail.helpTipsHowText: Search for the city in the search field and tap 'Generate'. The city is saved to the trip, and you can expand it to read the tips or tap ↻ to regenerate. You can add several cities per trip.
detail.helpDocumentsWhatText: Upload and store important travel documents such as flight tickets, passport copies and reservations in the cloud.
detail.helpDocumentsHowText: Expand the 'Travel documents' section by tapping the header, then tap '+' to upload a file. Give the document a title and an optional description. Tap 'Open' on a document to view or download it, and long-press to delete it.
detail.helpDocumentsTip: Documents are stored securely in the cloud (Firebase Storage) and require an internet connection to open.

mealPlanner.title: Our Meals
mealPlanner.importURL: Paste URL from matprat.no or similar
mealPlanner.helpWhatText: The weekly menu lets you plan meals for the whole week. You can add breakfast, lunch and dinner for each day, based on your recipe book.
mealPlanner.helpHowText: Use the ◀ ▶ arrows to browse weeks. Tap a meal slot (e.g. '+ Dinner') to choose a recipe from the book. Tap a planned meal to view the recipe or remove it from the plan.
mealPlanner.helpTip: Use 'Copy from last week' to reuse last week's plan, and the Profile settings to show or hide breakfast, lunch and dinner.
mealPlanner.helpSettingsText: In the profile under Food center you can choose which meal types to show: Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner.
mealPlanner.helpRandomTitle: What should we have for dinner today
mealPlanner.helpRandomWhatText: Out of inspiration for tonight's dinner? Tap the button and we'll suggest a dish from your recipe book.
mealPlanner.helpRandomHowText: Tap 'Random dish' to get a suggestion. Tap 'Add to weekly plan' to add it as today's dinner, or 'View recipe' to open it.
mealPlanner.helpRandomSettingsText: Suggestions come from your recipe book under Food center.
mealPlanner.helpSearchWhatText: Search your recipe book by name. In the same tab you can also filter by categories such as Chicken, Vegetarian and Pasta.
mealPlanner.helpSearchHowText: Type a keyword in the search field. If the search returns no matches, you can use AI search to generate new recipes based on your description.
mealPlanner.helpSearchTip: You can also import recipes from websites with the 🔗 button, or photograph a recipe with the 📷 button.
mealPlanner.helpSearchSettingsText: All recipes are saved in Food center under the Recipes tab.
mealPlanner.helpAiSearchWhatText: AI search uses artificial intelligence to suggest new recipes based on what you type, when the search in your book returns no matches.
mealPlanner.helpAiSearchHowText: Type a keyword in the search field. If no matches appear, tap 'Search with AI'. Choose which country the recipes should come from — the AI generates three suggestions with ingredients and instructions.
mealPlanner.helpAiSearchTip: Tap 'Save' on a suggestion to add it to your recipe book. You can then edit it like any regular recipe.
mealPlanner.helpHandlelisteWhatText: Shopping lists let you collect items you need to buy. You can create your own lists or get ingredients automatically from recipes.
mealPlanner.helpHandlelisteHowText: Tap '+' to create a new shopping list. Enter the name and tap 'Add' — you'll go straight into the new list. Long-press a list to delete it.
mealPlanner.helpHandlelisteRecipeText: When you open a recipe and tap 'Add to shopping list', a new list named after the recipe is created (or the ingredients are added to an existing list with the same name).
mealPlanner.helpHandlelisteRecipeTip: The ingredients are translated into the language you have selected in the app.
mealPlanner.helpWeekOverviewWhatText: The week overview shows the weekly meal plan with breakfast, lunch and dinner for each day. You can navigate between weeks using the arrows.
mealPlanner.helpWeekOverviewHowText: Tap a meal slot to add or change a recipe. Use ◀ and ▶ to view other weeks. Tap 'Back to current week' to return.
mealPlanner.helpWeekOverviewTip: You can copy last week's plan by tapping the copy button at the bottom.
mealPlanner.helpWeekMenuWhatText: The weekly menu shows the meals for each day of the week. You can navigate between weeks with the arrows and plan breakfast, lunch and dinner for each day.
mealPlanner.helpWeekMenuHowText: Tap the '+' button at a meal to choose a recipe (with search). Tap a planned meal to view the recipe or remove it from the plan. If you're on a different week, tap 'Back to this week'.
mealPlanner.helpWeekMenuTip: Use 'Copy from last week' at the bottom to reuse last week's plan — the button only appears when the week is empty.
mealPlanner.whatToEat: What should we have for dinner today?

pets.name: Name
pets.helpWhatText: Here you can manage all the family's pets. Add pets with name, type, breed, gender, birthday, chip ID, passport number and photo. For each pet you can keep track of vet visits, medications, feeding, grooming, vaccinations and insurance.
pets.helpHowText: Tap '+' to add a new pet. Tap a pet to see details and add information in the various sections. Long-press a pet to edit or delete it. In each section tap '+' to add new entries, and long-press to edit or delete.
pets.helpTip: Vet visits sync to the family's Google calendar, and vaccinations with a date are added as events. New visits and vaccinations also trigger push notifications to the family.
pets.helpFeaturesText: Vet visits: Plan visits with date, time, location, participants, reminder, documents and repeats. Medications: Track medications with dosage, frequency and per-dose reminders. Feeding: Plan feeding routines with time and amount. Grooming: Keep track of coat care and clipping. Vaccinations: Register vaccines with next due date, reminder and status. Insurance: Save insurer, policy number, duration and documents.

homes.helpWhatText: Here you can add all your homes — house, summer cabin, winter cabin and apartment. For each home you can open instructions, maintenance and projects.
homes.helpHowText: Tap the 'Add home' card to create a home. Fill in name, type, address (postal code and city are filled in automatically), description and optionally a photo. Long-press a home to edit or delete it.
homes.receiptNoItemsText: Could not read items from the receipt. Try again with a clearer image.
homes.noUnlinkedItemsText: All shopping items are already linked to tasks.
homes.servicesDeletedForRemovedDays: services were deleted for removed days.
homes.instruksjonerHelpWhatText: Instructions let you store important information about your home that you can share with the family. Share instructions for "Coming home" and "Leaving home" — such as alarm codes, Wi-Fi passwords, key locations and similar.
homes.instruksjonerHelpHowText: Tap '+' in a section to add an instruction. Enter title and content manually, or use 'Scan note' (camera) or 'Scan from gallery' to let AI read handwritten notes and fill in the fields automatically. Long-press an instruction to edit or delete it.
homes.instruksjonerHelpTip: The AI scan also fills in the correct section and attaches a photo of the note.
homes.vedlikeholdHelpWhatText: Maintenance helps you keep track of service agreements and paint colors for your home. Plan recurring service with reminders and documents, and save paint colors with name, code, brand and room.
homes.vedlikeholdHelpHowText:
Service agreements: Tap '+' to add an agreement with title, person, date from/to, time, frequency (once/monthly/quarterly/yearly) and reminder. Use 'Schedule repeat' to create agreements on specific weekdays over several weeks, with support for every other week. You can also attach photos or documents.

Paint colors: Tap '+' to add a color. Use 'Photograph label' or 'Photograph wall' to let AI read the color, or enter a color code and tap 'Fetch color' to look it up automatically.
homes.vedlikeholdHelpTip: Long-press a service agreement or paint color to edit or delete it. Service agreements appear in "Your week", and paint colors linked to a project are edited in the project.
homes.prosjektHelpWhatText: Projects collect everything related to a renovation or maintenance project: paint colors, shopping list with prices, offers from suppliers, a task board and a budget overview.
homes.prosjektHelpHowText: Tap '+' to create a project with title, description, budget, start date and status. Tap a project to open it. In the project you get AI suggestions for tasks and shopping items, can scan receipts with AI, add supplier offers, and move tasks between 'Todo', 'In progress' and 'Done' with the arrow buttons. The budget is set on the project and shown as a spending overview.
homes.prosjektHelpTip: Link shopping list items to tasks to keep track of what is needed for each task. Long-press a project to edit or delete it.
